columns.name: transaction_type

columns.name: category

columns.name: category_raw
columns.semantic_note: original native category/type string, always preserved even when category is 'unknown'. For Trade Republic rows this is 'NATIVE_CATEGORY / NATIVE_TYPE' (e.g. 'TRADING / BUY' vs 'TRADING / SELL') — the only place a buy is distinguishable from a sell, since transaction_type and category both collapse to 'investment' for both (see TRADE_REPUBLIC_TYPE_MAP in money_ingest.py). columns.name: merchant

columns.name: description_full
